newsitem.title: USA: Fiserv to acquire BHC Financial.
newsitem.headline: Fiserv to acquire BHC Financial.

text.p: Fiserv Inc., a major provider of independent trust services, said Monday it has agreed to acquire BHC Financial Inc. in a stock deal worth about $215 million.
Philadelphia-based BHC Financial provides securities processing and support services to banks, insurance companies, brokerage firms, money managers and mutual fund companies.
Under the agreement, Brookfield, Wis.-based Fiserv will offer $33.50 worth of its stock for each of BHC's 6.4 million shares outstanding in a pooling of interests.
The exchange ratio will be determined by taking the average of the closing price of Fiserv common stock for the last 20 trading days ending two days prior to closing.
BHC's stock shot up $11.50 or more than 50 percent to $31.50 on Nasdaq. Fiserv rose $2.125 to $34.875, also on Nasdaq.

"This transaction is a timely extension for Fiserv to move into the securities processing business in support of our bank clients that offer a broad array of investment products and services to their customer base, " said George Dalton, chairman and chief executive of Fiserv.
The agreement is subject to all normal conditions to closing, including receipt of all necessary regulatory consents and BHC shareholder approval.
BHC Financial, through its principal business unit BHC Securities, Inc. and related subsidiaries, earned $18.0 million on revenues of $81.2 million last year.

Fiserv is an independent provider of financial data processing systems and related information management services and products to more than 5,000 banks, credit unions, mortgage firms and savings institutions worldwide.
Its Fiserv Trust Group is the nation's largest provider of independent trust services for self-directed individual retirement accounts.
